---
title: "Explore"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: false
---

```{css}
#| echo: false
body.template-article .container.main-container {
  max-width: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  padding-left: clamp(0.35rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
  padding-right: clamp(0.35rem, 1vw, 0.9rem);
}

body.template-article main {
  max-width: none;
}

body.template-article .row {
  margin-left: 0;
  margin-right: 0;
}

body.template-article main > .row > [class*="col-"] {
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;
}

body.template-article .page-header {
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.quarto-title-block,
.article-meta {
  display: none;
}

.explore-shell {
  width: 100%;
}

.explore-lede {
  max-width: none;
  margin: 0 0 0.9rem 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
}

.explore-link {
  color: #396175;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.explore-frame {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: calc(100vh - 11rem);
  min-height: 820px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(57, 97, 117, 0.18);
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 18px 50px rgba(57, 97, 117, 0.08);
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
  .explore-frame {
    height: calc(100vh - 12rem);
    min-height: 760px;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
  body.template-article .container.main-container {
    padding-left: 0.35rem;
    padding-right: 0.35rem;
  }

  .explore-lede {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
  }

  .explore-frame {
    height: calc(100vh - 10.5rem);
    min-height: 680px;
    border-radius: 0.35rem;
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
devtools::load_all()
explorer_url <- codec:::codec_explorer_url()
```

<div class="explore-shell">
<p class="explore-lede">
The explorer below is embedded from Posit Connect Cloud.
If it does not load in your browser, open it directly:
<a class="explore-link" href="`r explorer_url`" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">launch the full explorer</a>.
</p>

<iframe
  class="explore-frame"
  src="`r explorer_url`"
  title="CoDEC Explorer"
  loading="lazy"
  referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
></iframe>
</div>
